name: Eye of Yawgmoth
description: A black sphere implanted in Belbe so Yawgmoth could observe; she disabled it.

timeline.summary: In Phyrexia, Abcal-dro reconstructs Avila's body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: A black sphere was then implanted in her body

timeline.summary: Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, and falls in love with Ertai.
timeline.quote: She disabled the Eye of Yawgmoth implanted in her
